purpose: Test the feature-only boosted-tree model's dependence on Number and the demonstrated Tot sum ratio routes
fit: Same ordered 270326 sampled rows, full-fit population counts, sqrt-frequency class objective, fixed 100-stage 800-tree recipe and scaler as feature-expert v1
mask: Set only the named standardized columns to zero during both training and prediction; preserve all 39 slots; retrain from scratch
panel: Before fitting/scoring, exclude original audit rows whose exact canonical 37-feature vector matches ANY row in the entire fit partition; retain all other rows and freeze the same population for every arm and central control
membership: Label-blind exact little-endian float32 bytes with signed-zero normalization; report sampled-fit and unsampled-fit matches separately; stop if any class disappears
controls: Independently refit full39 at all seeds and require historical model and original-audit prediction/metric identity; re-score frozen central neural predictions on the common eligible panel
budget: Nine fresh fits per run, 7200 trees total; all models frozen before any model audit scoring; full independent replay; no neural training
primary: Paired final-at-fixed-budget metrics on the common eligible audit population; report macro-F1, all eight class precision/recall/F1, benign false alerts and confusion matrices
secondary: Original 408027-row audit for every arm, separately labeled; never mix populations in a treatment contrast
interpretation: Report signed paired differences, not a selected best seed or mask. Joint masking removes legitimate size information too and does not prove shortcut-free or cross-session behavior. Reuse previous rare-F1/FAR screen versus central only as a descriptive diagnostic, not promotion
